description: This file defines the interface for a logging module in the Starboard platform, including log levels, logging functions, and thread-safe output methods.

methods.name: SbLog
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority to the platform's debug output log.

methods.name: SbLogRaw
methods.description: Logs a raw message in an async-signal-safe manner.

methods.name: SbLogRawDumpStack
methods.description: Dumps the current thread's stack trace in an async-signal-safe manner.

methods.name: SbLogRawFormat
methods.description: Logs a formatted message in an async-signal-safe manner using va_list.

methods.name: SbLogFormat
methods.description: Logs a formatted message with variable arguments.

methods.name: SbLogIsTty
methods.description: Indicates if the log output is directed to a TTY.
